title: SAML metadata renewal for the agency IdP

articles.subject: SAML metadata renewal for the agency IdP
articles.body:
Hi,

Our signing certificate expires 20 August. New metadata is attached. Please load it in good time, we do not want a repeat of last year when everyone lost access on a Monday morning.

/Tobias Ahl

articles.subject: Re: SAML metadata renewal for the agency IdP
articles.body:
Hi Tobias,

Loaded in your test environment now. Both certificates are configured in parallel, so the old one keeps working until it expires and the new one is accepted immediately. No cutover moment needed.

Please verify a login in test and I will do the same in production.

Regards,
Jonas

articles.subject: Re: SAML metadata renewal for the agency IdP
articles.body:
Verified in test and in production. Good that we did it a few weeks early this time.

/Tobias
